clarified_intent.description: Independently audit the A2A implementation and archive evidence so KBD does not overclaim release readiness.

constraints: All claimed A2A behavior must have executable source or packed-artifact evidence.
Public exports, declarations, examples, skills, and release docs must agree.
Known protocol, platform, security, visual, and publication limits must remain explicit.
No visual evidence may be fabricated for a headless protocol boundary.
Deterministic tests, types, lint, package contracts, and structured evidence must pass.

target_state.description: A technically sound, reproducible archive bundle with no unsupported full-3.0 or publication claim.
success_criteria: A2A conformance and release tests pass
Evidence JSON parses and referenced evidence exists
